dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the staff in your hand...

dialogues.speaker: Aravinay
dialogues.text: Aravinay's staff is a precious staff that has heard many stories.

dialogues.speaker: Aravinay
dialogues.text: The pattern on the staff grows continuously, like the annual rings of a tree. The more stories it hears, the stronger the staff becomes.

dialogues.speaker: Aravinay
dialogues.text: One day, it will grow into a big tree full of stories.

dialogues.speaker: Aravinay
dialogues.text: If Nara friend were Aranara, you would surely understand.
